ready_rule: all Q01-Q12 and file_scope are met, no blocking requirement remains, and current candidate-bound verification evidence is available
not_ready_rule: one or more material requirements are partial or not_met, a blocker remains, or current verification is absent
condition_blinding: adjudicator receives exact candidate and source/task basis without configuration label where feasible
supersession: append-only candidate/task/rubric/evidence-bound reconciliation required for any conflicting judgment
